notes:
- Blanket and Zigzag outlines have editable pull compensation, cleaner acute-angle stitching, and better spacing through calligraphic turns. Blanket adds a Rail stitches control.
- Zigzag outlines support two independently configurable underlay layers. Choose Center Run, Edge Run, Zigzag, Double Zigzag, Tatami, or Double Tatami.
- Single Tatami underlay can sew across the outline, and consecutive Tatami passes plan their transitions together before the cover stitches.
- Projects saved with the new outline settings require StitchFits 0.2.217 or later.
